title: candle-metal calibration: one real point, no fit yet
summary: Records single Qwen3-0.6B Metal peak-memory measurement (53.4GB at batch=2×seq=512), explains why this point cannot be fitted into a model, surfaces batch-size silencing bug.
notes: Empirical measurement record with single data point. Explicitly explains why a second point is needed (one equation, one unknown). Separate finding on batch-size silencing bug is flagged as non-blocker. Supporting research artifact, not a decision.
